vocabulary.YES: the render shows the named condition (defects noted in shows)
vocabulary.YES-NO-VISIBLE-DIFFERENCE: the condition was constructed but the page draws nothing that depends on it
vocabulary.NO: the render shows a different condition; shows says which and why
vocabulary.NOT-RENDERABLE: the product has no on-screen form of this state (row W3-S1)
